source.name: SportsPro: 'Toronto FC ink ten-year BMO shirt sponsorship and naming rights renewal'
source.quote: retain naming rights to Toronto FC's 30,000 capacity home.
source.note: BMO Field has carried BMO's name since the stadium opened in 2007 ('a partner that has been with Toronto FC, and the stadium, since day one', club press release); ten-year naming-rights renewals were also announced in 2016 and in June 2022.

note: BMO Field naming rights, renewed for ten years as part of the June 2022 BMO partnership extension. Earliest naming: club press release of 2016 says BMO has been a partner of the stadium 'since day one' (opened April 2007 as BMO Field).
